questions.prompt: One of the following is not a mechanism against heat loss
questions.explanation: Vasoconstriction and shivering reduce heat loss or make heat. Vasodilation increases blood flow to the skin and increases heat loss, so it is not a mechanism against heat loss.

questions.prompt: In a cold room, skin arterioles

questions.prompt: Shivering helps against heat loss because it

questions.prompt: Vasodilation of skin vessels is used when the body needs to

questions.prompt: When blood osmotic pressure increases, there will be
options: Less water reabsorption in the kidneys
questions.explanation: High blood osmotic pressure (dehydration) triggers ADH. ADH increases water reabsorption and decreases urine volume.

questions.prompt: ADH acts on the kidney to
options: make more urea from fat only
questions.explanation: ADH makes collecting ducts permeable to water.

questions.prompt: A fall in blood osmotic pressure leads to
questions.explanation: Dilute blood turns ADH off so extra water is lost.

questions.prompt: The hormone that reduces urine volume is
questions.explanation: Antidiuretic hormone reduces urine.

questions.prompt: The embryonic root of a seed is the

questions.prompt: The embryonic shoot of a seed is the

questions.prompt: Food-storing seed leaves are

questions.prompt: On a warm bright day, in a wet environment, the factor that most often limits the rate of photosynthesis is
questions.explanation: Warm, bright and wet means temperature, light and water are not limiting. CO₂ in air is only about 0.04%, so CO₂ usually limits.

questions.prompt: A product of photosynthesis that is not the usual limiting raw material is

questions.prompt: In a dark room photosynthesis is limited by
questions.explanation: No light means the light-dependent stage stops.

questions.prompt: The raw materials of photosynthesis are
questions.explanation: CO₂ + H₂O (plus light and chlorophyll) make sugar.
